coatesgroup-coatesgroup:lever:614e13b5-0.title: Service & Hardware Support Specialist
coatesgroup-coatesgroup:lever:614e13b5-0.description: Be Part of Our Next Chapter For over almost 60 years, our solutions have enabled impactful connections between some of the world’s leading brands and their customers. And while we’ve already done a lot of work we’re proud of, we’re just getting started! We’re a global technology company focused on creating dynamic, smart, personalised and engaging customer experiences powered by our range of digital hardware, our proprietary content management system and our industry leading signage solutions. (For example: If you’ve ordered in-store or in the drive-thru at McDonald’s somewhere in the world in the last few years, chances are you’ve interacted with our digital solutions.) We work in over 50 global markets and have 9 offices around the world, with a global headquarters proudly located in our founding home of Sydney, Australia. Coates Group has the values of a family-owned business and the innovative spirit of a start-up, both which fuel our purpose – Creating Connections. Empowering Partnerships. Always Evolving. Through hard work, dedication and creativity, we’ve become industry leaders who have won awards and set records while remaining focused on continual growth and evolution. We are a 2x Australia Good Design Award winner and successfully completed the largest hardware deployment in Quick Service Restaurant history. We are curious, charismatic, authentic and we value and leverage the diversity of our crew. We are imaginers, kindness enthusiasts, experts, creators, thinkers, challengers, collaborators and over-achievers. And together, as a Crew, we are revolutionizing the way the world’s leading brands leverage technology to drive the best customer experiences. To lead and optimise post-sales service operations across the business unit by delivering effective customer support, building scalable service capability, and enabling high-quality service outcomes. The role is responsible for developing service networks, driving operational efficiency, strengthening customer support processes, supporting project delivery, and identifying service-related revenue opportunities while maintaining strong cross-functional relationships.
responsibilities: Service Network & Capability - Develop and maintain a scalable and effective post-sales service capability across India to support customer demand and enable consistent service delivery. ​
Establish and expand local service support networks across key states and locations in line with business  requirements. ​
Develop and implement support standards and processes to improve service effectiveness and customer  experience. ​
Deliver training and capability development initiatives across the service support network and service teams. ​

Service Delivery & Operational Excellence - Ensure efficient and high-quality delivery of post-sales services through effective service coordination, performance management and operational governance. ​
Coordinate, manage and attend service activities and customer support requirements as needed. ​
Deliver service outcomes within agreed turnaround times (TAT) and customer commitments. ​
Manage service documentation and reporting, including service call logs, weekly updates, warranty  records and materials tracking. ​
Monitor service performance and support continuous improvement initiatives. ​
Service Commercial Performance - Support business growth through the development and expansion of service- led revenue opportunities. ​
Develop and implement Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) models for the India market. ​
Support forecasting and revenue projections associated with service offerings. ​
Identify and drive additional revenue opportunities through out-of-warranty component sales and services. ​
Customer & Stakeholder Management  - Build trusted customer and internal partnerships to support service excellence and long-term operational outcomes. ​
Develop and  maintain strong working relationships with customer project teams and internal stakeholders. ​
Partner with production teams to support ongoing availability of replacement components. ​
Drive positive customer outcomes and contribute to strong customer satisfaction and QBR results.
qualifications: Demonstrated technical knowledge of electrical and electronic equipment, materials, manufacturing processes and industrial machinery. ​
Experience supporting post-sales service delivery,  troubleshooting and customer support activities within a technical or operational environment. ​
Strong capability in planning,  coordinating and executing multiple workstreams, with sound problem-solving and critical thinking skills. ​
Ability to interpret and apply technical standards, operating  procedures and service requirements to support service outcomes. ​
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and confidence working with operational reports, service data and performance  tracking. Salesforce experience desirable. ​
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and local language(s); understanding of South Indian  languages is advantageous . ​
Demonstrated ability to build effective working relationships across customers,  suppliers and cross-functional internal teams.

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:66e16781-e77.title: GTM Automation Engineer, (Clay, Instantly)
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:66e16781-e77.description: About Wing Wing is one of the world’s largest virtual talent companies, venture-backed and based in San Francisco. Leveraging our global scale, millions of applicants, and deep operational expertise, we’re now building next-generation AI and automation products. Across both sides of our business, we help companies automate workflows, scale revenue, and unlock world-class global talent. As part of this evolution, we are building a high-scale outbound engine to reach SMBs and mid-market companies at scale. This requires a new kind of role - one that blends engineering, automation, experiment velocity, and GTM execution. About the Role We are hiring a full-time GTM Automation Engineer to architect, automate, and optimize our outbound growth systems. This is a hybrid role combining Clay automation expertise, light engineering, outbound infrastructure, experimentation, and crisp copywriting. You will build and maintain the machine behind our outbound engine: Clay workflows, enrichment pipelines, domain infrastructure, multi-tool integrations, personalization systems, and data dashboards. You will run high-velocity experiments, write conversion-focused outbound copy, troubleshoot deliverability, and scale sending volume across hundreds of thousands of leads. You will work closely with our marketing, product, and sales teams - but you will own your domain with a high degree of autonomy. The systems you build will directly drive pipeline, revenue, and go-to-market strategy. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role that sits at the intersection of engineering and growth. The impact you make here will be massive. Responsibilities You will own the entire outbound automation machine, including: 1. Clay Workflows & Lead Infrastructure - Build advanced Clay workflows for scraping, enrichment, verification, scoring, routing, and personalization - Use APIs, webhooks, and custom code steps to automate data pipelines - Create ICP logic, trigger systems, and multi-step lead flows 2. Multi-Domain Email Infrastructure, Deliverability, Verification - Set up hundreds, up to thousands of domains, warming, DNS, DMARC, DKIM, SPF - Build scalable campaign systems in Instantly using Apollo data - Know the ins and outs of email verification: LeadMagic, BounceBan, and more - Maintain deliverability and sending health across all domains - Implement verification, cleansing, and bounce prevention 3. Experiments & Optimization - Ship several outbound experiments per week, measure results - Test variations of copy, subject lines, offers, personas - Build dashboards to track open → reply → meeting → revenue - Identify bottlenecks and improve system performance continuously 4. Copywriting & Messaging - Write clear outbound emails and short-form sequences - Use Clay’s AI rewriting + dynamic variables for deep personalization - Create persona-based messaging frameworks 5. Data & Engineering Tasks - Write small scripts (Python, JavaScript) when needed - Integrate tools through API calls and workflows - Clean, transform, and normalize data - Maintain accurate metrics and reporting Outcomes You Will Be Accountable For Scaling outbound sending volume from 5k → 50k → 250k+ emails/month Improving reply rates and meeting-booked rates through experimentation Reducing cost per qualified meeting Building a predictable outbound funnel that feeds Sales every day Ensuring strong deliverability across all domains and systems Automating manual steps so the outbound engine becomes self-sustaining Requirements Must-Have - Expert-level Clay experience (advanced formulas, automations, integrations) - Strong experience with Apollo and Instantly - Ability to write clean, concise outbound copy in English - Experience setting up email domains, DNS, verification, warming - Ability to write scripts with Python/JS - Strong data skills (normalization, dedupe, cleansing, schema design) - Experience running large-scale outbound campaigns - Strong analytical and experimentation mindset -

jobgether-jobgether:lever:14cd1bd1-23ff-.title: Azure Data Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:14cd1bd1-23ff-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Azure Data Engineer based in United Kingdom. This role offers the opportunity to strengthen cybersecurity operations by engineering reliable, scalable security data pipelines across cloud and on-premises environments. You will work with high volumes of security telemetry and help ensure critical data is available for threat detection, incident response, compliance, and cyber risk visibility. The position combines hands-on data engineering with cybersecurity, cloud technologies, automation, and data quality management. You’ll collaborate with application, infrastructure, security, governance, and vendor teams to onboard and optimize diverse data sources. The role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys troubleshooting complex ingestion challenges and improving system reliability and efficiency. You’ll operate in a highly regulated financial services environment where data integrity, security, and operational excellence are essential. This is an opportunity to make a direct impact on the organization’s ability to detect, investigate, and respond to cyber threats. Design, build, and maintain scalable security data ingestion pipelines for SIEM and cloud data platforms, including Azure Data Explorer and Log Analytics. Parse, normalize, transform, enrich, and validate structured and unstructured security telemetry using regex, JSON parsing, schema mapping, and other data-processing techniques. Partner with application owners, infrastructure and cloud teams, vendors, security stakeholders, and other internal groups to onboard new log sources and validate end-to-end data flows. Ensure the integrity, completeness, timeliness, and quality of security telemetry used for monitoring, detection, incident response, reporting, and risk management. Align security data with established schemas, naming conventions, governance standards, and organizational requirements to support downstream analytics and automation. Troubleshoot ingestion, parsing, transformation, schema, and data-quality issues across diverse platforms and environments. Maintain clear documentation covering log onboarding procedures, source requirements, data mappings, pipeline configurations, and operational support processes. Collaborate with detection engineering and security operations teams to ensure telemetry supports investigation, threat detection, response, and cyber risk use cases. Conduct telemetry gap analyses, identify missing or incomplete data sources, and recommend priorities for improving security coverage. Support logging practices that meet regulatory, audit, compliance, retention, and data-integrity requirements. Improve ingestion frameworks, automation, and onboarding processes to increase scalability, repeatability, reliability, and cost efficiency. Support infrastructure-as-code, scripting, and automation initiatives that streamline deployment and ongoing pipeline maintenance. Monitor pipeline performance and work with stakeholders to optimize ingestion reliability, throughput, and operational costs. Stay current with emerging cybersecurity telemetry formats, logging standards, data engineering practices, and cloud security data-platform capabilities. Requirements: 3+ years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, data engineering, log management, security operations, or a related technology discipline. Hands-on experience onboarding, managing, and validating log sources within SIEM, cloud data platforms, or security analytics environments. Strong understanding of data parsing, normalization, transformation, and validation, including experience with regex, JSON, XML, CSV, and both structured and unstructured data. Familiarity with security telemetry from network, endpoint, identity, application, cloud, and infrastructure environments. jobgether-jobgether:lever:dfb29950-3be9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Coder II based in the United States. This is a full-time remote opportunity for an experienced medical coder supporting complex orthopedic and procedural services. The role focuses on accurate medical record review, ICD-10-CM and CPT coding, billing data integrity, and regulatory compliance. You will work across practice management and hospital record systems to ensure procedures and patient information are coded appropriately. The position also provides an opportunity to collaborate directly with physicians and clinical teams on documentation and coding standards. Success in this role requires strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to research complex or unfamiliar procedures. You will work independently while managing consistent coding volumes, quality standards, payer requirements, and timely turnaround. The role offers a collaborative healthcare environment with opportunities for professional development and career growth. Review and interpret medical records and clinical documentation to accurately assign ICD-10-CM diagnosis and CPT procedure codes in accordance with applicable coding guidelines and regulations. Abstract relevant clinical and demographic information while ensuring accurate and complete coding for scheduled and unscheduled surgical procedures. Use practice management systems and hospital medical record platforms to validate patient information, services performed, and documentation required for appropriate coding and billing. Review operative reports and complex clinical documentation to select codes based on the procedures actually documented. Apply CPT, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS Level II, modifiers, NCCI edits, global surgical guidelines, and payer-specific requirements consistently. Identify and resolve coding edits, documentation discrepancies, and potential compliance concerns, escalating complex cases when appropriate. Coordinate with physicians and clinical staff to obtain missing documentation and provide clarification regarding coding-related issues. Educate and support providers and clinical teams on appropriate documentation and coding practices to promote accurate billing and regulatory compliance. Conduct research into unfamiliar procedures, coding guidelines, payer requirements, and other issues affecting coding accuracy. Collaborate with Coding leadership, Authorization, Revenue Cycle, providers, and other operational teams to resolve issues effectively. Maintain productivity, accuracy, quality, and turnaround expectations while working independently with limited supervision. Adapt to multiple specialties, changing payer requirements, and evolving coding standards while maintaining strong professional judgment. Requirements: 3–5 years of professional medical coding experience , ideally within a multispecialty environment involving orthopedics, surgery, pain management, spine, or other complex procedural coding. High school diploma, GED, or equivalent working knowledge preferred. Current professional coding certification such as CPC, CCS, COC, or equivalent ; certification through AHIMA or AAPC is preferred/required according to organizational standards. Demonstrated expertise in CPT, ICD-10-CM, HCPCS Level II, modifiers, NCCI edits, global surgical guidelines, and payer-specific coding requirements. Strong experience reviewing operative reports and clinical documentation and accurately assigning codes based on documented services. Experience resolving coding edits and documentation discrepancies; exposure to coding audits, payer guidelines, NCCI edits, and physician queries is strongly preferred. Strong analytical, research, critical-thinking, and problem-solving abilities. Exceptional attention to detail and a strong commitment to coding accuracy, compliance, and data integrity. jobgether-jobgether:lever:fca020f9-da0c-.title: Senior Marketing Coordinator
jobgether-jobgether:lever:fca020f9-da0c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Marketing Coordinator based in the United States. This is an opportunity for an experienced AEC marketing professional to play a central role in developing high-impact proposals, qualifications packages, and client-facing materials. You’ll support complex federal pursuits while collaborating with marketing, technical, project management, and business development professionals across multiple service lines. The role combines proposal strategy, content development, project coordination, and quality control in a deadline-driven environment. You’ll manage multiple concurrent pursuits, take ownership of major proposal sections, and help teams deliver compliant, compelling submissions. Your ability to understand client needs, identify relevant project experience, and translate technical information into persuasive content will directly support growth opportunities. The position offers significant collaboration and autonomy, making it well suited to a detail-oriented self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced professional services environment. This is a fully remote opportunity, with occasional travel to offices and meetings as needed. Support proposal teams consisting of marketing professionals, pursuit and proposal managers, client managers, project managers, and subject matter experts in developing proposals, shortlist interviews, and professional presentations. Manage major components of multiple proposal efforts simultaneously across target markets, service offerings, and client pursuits. Develop a strong understanding of individual pursuits, client requirements, and competitive considerations to proactively recommend improvements to content, strategy, and processes. Coordinate proposal efforts across multiple offices and service lines, including integrated Civil, Structural, Architecture, MEP, Technology, and other multidisciplinary teams. Develop and coordinate a wide range of proposal formats, including SF330s, design-build submissions, technical narratives, pricing and business proposals, RFQs, RFIs, Sources Sought responses, and oral presentations. Support capture planning through proposal drafting, content development, data management, documentation, editing, deadline tracking, and coordination with subject matter experts, project managers, and external partners. Lead major proposal sections or volumes, including subconsultant proposal packages, ensuring content is complete, accurate, persuasive, and compliant. Lead proposal kickoff meetings, review sessions, and relevant client management or business development meetings as needed. Write and edit proposal and sales materials, including project descriptions, resumes, market segment overviews, cover letters, executive summaries, and related collateral. Coordinate subconsultant data calls and ensure required information is collected, reviewed, and incorporated on schedule. Maintain consistent corporate standards across proposals, resumes, presentation graphics, and marketing collateral. Perform thorough QA/QC reviews of proposals and marketing materials to ensure accuracy, consistency, compliance, and professional presentation. Support internal and external marketing communications, including conference preparation, blog and article development, and client presentations. Build familiarity with organizational project experience and identify relevant capabilities and past performance for current pursuits. Support client management and business development teams through market research, competitor analysis, client intelligence, and conference preparation. Maintain accurate marketing information, CRM records, shared files, and proposal resources to ensure materials are organized and readily accessible. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Design, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience in AEC marketing. 6

skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:6c94134b-ba9d-439f.title: Backend Engineer
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:6c94134b-ba9d-439f.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми в пошуку PHP/Go Backend Engineer. Виклики, які чекають на цій ролі: - Розвивати backend-логіку для карткових оплат і альтернативних платіжних методів. - Працювати з інтеграціями з платіжними провайдерами та нестандартними сценаріями їхньої роботи. - Покращувати успішність оплат - Робити платіжні процеси стабільнішими, швидшими й прозорішими через якісне логування, моніторинг, метрики та автоматизацію - Долучатися до технічних рішень у критичній частині продукту та брати відповідальность за їхню якість Яку людину ми шукаємо: - Береш відповідальність за результат і ведеш фічу повним циклом: від ідеї до стабільної роботи, моніторингу й підтримки - Бачиш за технічними задачами бізнес-потребу та пропонуєш рішення, що справді її закривають; - Самостійно занурюєшся в контекст, ухвалюєш обґрунтовані рішення й умієш пояснити команді, чому обрано саме такий підхід; - Маєш сильний практичний досвід з PHP і готовий посилювати сервіс та команду своєю експертизою; - Сприймаєш архітектуру як щоденний інструмент для створення надійних, зрозумілих і масштабованих рішень. Буде перевагою: - Досвід у payments, fintech, e-commerce або інших high-load системах - Досвід роботи з observability: метрики, алерти, моніторинг - Досвід розробки на GoLang - Досвід повноцінної інтеграціії платіжних методів - Участь у технічних ініціативах: покращенні процесів, стандартів розробки та архітектури. У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: - SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. - Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. strategichr-strategichr:greenhouse:79187.description: Job Opportunity: Field Service Technician with Allied Technical Service in Buckner, KY $3,000 Sign-On Bonus Allied Technical Services is hiring a Field Service Technician for our Pump Rental Branch in Buckner, KY, just outside Louisville. This is a hands-on role where you’ll work with a team to install, service, deliver, and operate temporary pump and piping systems used on water and wastewater infrastructure projects throughout the surrounding region. Location: Buckner, KY (just outside Louisville) Pay: $18.50/hr (entry-level) up to $21/hr. (experienced), plus substantial overtime. Incremental pay increases as you complete training and become proficient in specific tasks. Sign-On Bonus: $3,000 sign-on bonus paid in staggered payments: $500 after 90 days, $1,000 at 6 months, and $1,500 after one year. Other Benefits Include: Generous PTO Guaranteed 40 hours/week In-house training Comprehensive benefits plan All safety equipment and consumables provided Company vehicle for travel to job sites Role Overview: We are seeking a Field Service Technician to join our Buckner, KY team. In this role, you will provide service, installation, delivery, and operation support for temporary portable pump and piping systems used in municipal, industrial, and construction markets. This role includes local and regional travel to job sites throughout the surrounding area. If you have mechanical skills, construction labor experience, or simply enjoy hands-on work and want to learn a skilled trade, this could be a great opportunity. We provide in-house training, steady hours, overtime opportunities, and a company vehicle for travel to job sites. To be successful, you will need to be flexible, adaptable, and eager to learn. Ability to operate lifting equipment including forklifts, extended boom forklifts, skid steers, tow motors, etc., preferred. Ability to complete documentation associated with customer rented deliverables. Physical demands of this role require bending, squatting, reaching, and lifting 25 lbs. or more and working indoor/outdoor conditions. Ability to participate in a rotating schedule of after-hours emergency response and on-call work. Valid driver’s license with a good driving record. Ability to obtain a DOT medical card. Must pass a drug and alcohol screening. Must pass a background check and complete Form I-9 Documents. Exposure to job site conditions: petro-chemical refineries, mills, mines, construction sites, industrial/power plants, wastewater treatment plants, etc. Exposure to all outdoor weather conditions. Allied Technical Services, Inc. is an established, privately owned family business specializing in pumping equipment, pump rentals, temporary bypass systems, and related service support. We are currently seeking Field Service Technicians for our Pump Rental Branch located in Buckner, KY , just outside Louisville, KY . Allied Pump Rentals provides portable temporary pump and pipe system bypassing equipment used to transport water and wastewater during construction, maintenance, and infrastructure projects. We offer a challenging and rewarding career path, a supportive team culture, excellent base pay, overtime opportunities, and a competitive benefits package. To learn more about Allied Technical Services and the products and services that we provide, take a moment to review our website and LinkedIn page: https://www.alliedpumprentals.com/ https://www.linkedin.com/company/allied-technical-services-inc/ Don’t miss out! titanmsp-titan-msp:ashbyhq:a0b47deb-991e.title: Senior Product Engineer
titanmsp-titan-msp:ashbyhq:a0b47deb-991e.description: SENIOR PLATFORM ENGINEER About Titan: Titan is an AI holding company transforming IT services with its Augmented AI platform. We acquire and partner with the best Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and embed AI at the core of their operations, empowering technicians to work faster, smarter, and more strategically. Our augmented AI platform enables MSPs to scale like technology companies while delivering faster resolutions, better uptime, and more proactive, personalized support for their customers. In under a year, we’ve raised over $70M from General Catalyst, acquired market-leading MSPs like RFA, and deployed agents seeing real-world impact to productivity. Our team brings together AI product expertise from Scale AI, Google, MIT, and Stanford, with private equity experience from H.I.G. Capital and seasoned MSP executives who have led some of the industry’s top providers. Joining Titan means helping redefine how work is done in IT Services and building a $100B company. About The Role: As a Senior Product Engineer at Titan, you are a high-agency owner of our most ambitious product initiatives. We are looking for "engineers-as-founders" who thrive when given a high-level objective—like "Automate 40% of L1 support tickets"—and the autonomy to navigate from ideation to deployment independently. You’ll sit at the intersection of AI and real-world operations, working directly with our MSP partners to build AI-native products that solve their highest-stakes pain points. This is a "0 to 1" opportunity for a builder who wants to see their code fundamentally rewrite the economics of a multi-billion dollar industry. What You Will Do: - Own major product initiatives from idea through deployment and iteration. Make trade-offs. Ship. Measure results. Improve. - Work closely with our AI team to integrate LLMs and autonomous agents into practical, production-grade workflows. Build interfaces that technicians rely on daily. - Talk to users. Observe workflows. Identify inefficiencies. Translate ambiguity into product decisions that materially improve operations across acquired MSPs. - Move quickly without sacrificing quality. Write clean, maintainable code. Balance speed with durability. - Set the standard for product quality and engineering velocity as we scale. Who You Are: - You’ve built something from scratch — as a founder or early engineer. You thrive when given a goal and minimal instructions. - You care about outcomes, not just implementation. You think in terms of user impact and business leverage. - You take initiative. You don’t wait for permission. You close loops. - You can explain trade-offs clearly — to engineers, operators, and leadership. - You can build modern web applications end-to-end (e.g., React, TypeScript, Python, Node). You’re comfortable integrating AI into real systems. Bonus: - Experience in highly regulated or precision-driven environments (e.g., fintech, hedge funds, complex enterprise systems). - Experience as an early employee at a high-growth, venture-backed startup.
